a.title: Wagner brothers begin new NBA chapter on different paths
a.summary: After five years, brothers Franz and Moritz Wagner are no longer playing together for the Orlando Magic. In the new NBA season, their separation will likely mean the new "German" team is the Charlotte Hornets.

b.title: Das Ende der Wagners - auf getrennten Wegen in die neue NBA-Saison
b.summary: Nach fünf Jahren spielen die Brüder Franz und Moritz Wagner nicht mehr gemeinsam für die Orlando Magic. In der neuen NBA-Saison haben sie ganz unterschiedliche Rollen. Neuer "deutscher Klub" sind die Charlotte Hornets.

a.title: Brazil's Lula seals re-election in surprise win
a.summary: Brazil's President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva won an unprecedented fourth term in a tight runoff against Flavio Bolsonaro on Sunday (October 25). The far-right candidate and son of former President Jair Bolsonaro has refused to accept the results and said he would seek to annul the vote.

b.title: Lula da la vuelta a los resultados y gana el balotaje a la Presidencia de Brasil
b.summary: El progresista Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, de 80 años, dio la vuelta al panorama del balotaje de este domingo 25 de octubre frente al aspirante de extrema derecha Flávio Bolsonaro y logró la reelección como presidente de Brasil. a.title: Brazil: What challenges await Lula in his fourth term as president?
a.summary: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, nearly 81 years old, clinched a fourth term in a tight runoff against Flavio Bolsonaro on Sunday (October 25). He will have to wrestle with a divided Brazil, an unfriendly Congress, feeble public finances and a Donald Trump-shaped menace during his unprecedented fourth term.

b.title: Brasil: Lula lo logra una vez más y alcanza un histórico cuarto mandato
b.summary: 🇧🇷🗳️ Brasil fue a las urnas este 25 de octubre para mantener al presidente izquierdista, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, en el poder. El mandatario logró imponerse sobre el ultraderechista Flávio Bolsonaro tras un reñido balotaje.

a.title: Brazil's Lula wins historic fourth term
a.summary: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, nearly 81 years old, clinched a fourth term in a tight runoff against Flavio Bolsonaro on Sunday (October 26). The leftist leader won 51.7% of the vote, compared to 48.2% for the son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, official results showed. Bolsonaro has refused to accept the loss and said he would seek to annul the vote.

b.title: "Es imposible reconocer estas elecciones": Flávio Bolsonaro tras derrota ante Lula
b.summary: El senador y candidato opositor Flávio Bolsonaro aseguró que “es imposible reconocer” la victoria del presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva en la segunda vuelta de las elecciones de este domingo en Brasil, tras denunciar como fraude la decisión de un juez de ampliar en dos horas el horario de votación a petición del líder progresista.

a.title: Lula wins fourth term: What are the reactions in Brazil?
a.summary: Brazil's leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva was re-elected against all expectations on Sunday (October 25), but his conservative rival Flavio Bolsonaro refused to accept the loss and said he would seek to have the vote annulled. FRANCE 24's Jan Onoszko tells us more.

Après une campagne marquée par de profondes divisions, le pays se retrouve face à de nombreux défis économiques, sociaux et environnementaux. a.title: Lula beats Bolsonaro in Brazil runoff: What does it mean for Donald Trump?
a.summary: Lula defeated on Sunday (October 25) Flavio Bolsonaro in Brazil’s presidential election. But rather than conceding, Bolsonaro called for the result to be annulled. As the US midterms approach, the result raises questions about Trump’s influence and how his political allies respond when voters reject them. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Editor, Douglas Herbert, gives us his analysis.

b.title: Revers pour Trump, climat, numérique : pourquoi la victoire de Lula porte au-delà du Brésil
b.summary: Réélu dimanche face au candidat d'extrême droite Flavio Bolsonaro, le président brésilien Lula a déjoué les pronostics. Au-delà du Brésil, sa victoire constitue un revers pour Donald Trump et préserve un contrepoids en Amérique latine, notamment sur le climat et la régulation du numérique.

a.title: Football: Who will win the 2026 Ballon d'Or?
a.summary: The competition for this year's Ballon d'Or is tougher than ever. Who will succeed Ousmane Dembélé? Kylian Mbappé, Lamine Yamal and Harry Kane lead a star-studded field. FRANCE 24's Emily Boyle has more.

b.title: Le Ballon d’or promet une soirée de suspense
b.summary: La 70e cérémonie du Ballon d’or se tient ce lundi soir à Londres, avec une course au trophée annoncée comme particulièrement ouverte chez les hommes comme chez les femmes.
